membershipLanding.spotlightTitle: Your practice, without the mental math.
membershipLanding.spotlightBody: Choose a plan from a studio, book the classes that fit your week, and keep your momentum going. Memberships are made for people who want consistency without locking themselves into one routine.

benefits.unlimitedDescription: Practice more often without counting credits each time you book.
benefits.priorityDescription: Get closer to the front of the line when popular classes fill quickly.
benefits.flexibleDescription: Plans are managed by the studio, with cancellation terms shown before you pay.

membershipLanding.stepsTitle: A membership that fits real life
membershipLanding.stepsSubtitle: Start small, build a rhythm, and let your practice meet you where you are.
membershipLanding.step1Description: Compare studios and membership offers by location, style, and schedule.
membershipLanding.step2Description: Open an offer to review its price, duration, coverage, and studio terms.
membershipLanding.step3Description: Book your next class and use your membership to keep coming back.
membershipLanding.fitYes: You already practice regularly or want a gentle reason to make it a habit.
membershipLanding.fitMaybe: You want access to one studio's full timetable instead of paying class by class.
membershipLanding.fitNo: You are still trying different studios or only book a class occasionally.
membershipLanding.fitAlternative: Try a drop-in or class pack first
membershipLanding.faq1Question: Does one membership work at every studio?
membershipLanding.faq1Answer: Memberships belong to the studio that offers them. You can browse different plans and choose the one that matches where you want to practice.
membershipLanding.faq2Answer: The price and renewal details are shown on the membership offer before checkout. Payments are securely processed through Yogi.
membershipLanding.faq3Answer: Cancellation depends on the studio's terms. Always review the offer details before purchase so you know exactly what applies.
membershipLanding.bottomSubtitle: Explore membership offers from studios near you.
